rules: Only ids in `owned` whose live name also starts with own_prefix may be cancelled by gpu_batch.controller.
`peers` are the gpu worker's jobs: counted against our cap, never cancelled by this worker.
`count_conservatively_prefixes`: unlisted H100 workloads with these name prefixes are COUNTED as ours (so we launch less) but never cancelled.
Naming such as 'kg-extract' is another team's and is not inferred to be ours.
